name: Eyebrow
purpose: The composed section eyebrow: always a gradient BetweenLines wrapping a gradient Badge. Never hand-assembled.
rule: An eyebrow is ALWAYS `BetweenLines variant=gradient > Badge gradient`. A generator must not emit a bare badge as an eyebrow.

copyBudget.note: Measured character lengths of the 6 real eyebrows, recorded as a budget. The text itself is proprietary marketing copy and is deliberately not stored here.
